articles.summary: Bitcoin smashed past the $95,000 milestone, surging over 11% week-on-week. Major altcoins weren’t far behind — Ethereum, XRP, and Solana all clocked gains of at least 8%, signalling a broad market recovery and a fresh wave of liquidity. Leading DePIN tokens have posted double digit percentage gains signalling increased investor confidence. This is your Dabba time!
articles.title: Liquidity Returns, Bitcoin Crosses $95K, DePINs Boom – Time for More Dabba?
